sections.text_preview: Minutia Deviation Tool (MDT), version 1.0 (beta)

sections.title: 1.2 System Overview
sections.text_preview: The MDT is a prototype Computer Software Configuration Item (CSCI) (i.e., software utility) that shall aid a user in designating equivalent minutia pairs across two fingerprint biometric images and ca

sections.title: 1.3 Document Overview
sections.text_preview: The Software Requirements Specification (SRS) document specifies the required functionality, capabilities, computer interfaces, and usability for the MDT.

sections.title: 1.3.1 Thresholds and Objectives
sections.text_preview: Each requirement shall have a threshold value or an objective value. Requirements labeled [T] indicate Threshold requirements. Requirements labeled [O] indicate Objective requirements.

sections.title: UNCLASSIFIED
sections.text_preview:
For requirements, "threshold" shall mean the minimum acceptable value that, in the user's judgment, is necessary to satisfy the need.

sections.title: 3.1 Required States and Modes
sections.text_preview: No states or modes are required. [T]

b. The MDT shall display the fingerprint image. [T]

sections.text_preview:

sections.title: 3.3.2 EBTS Files
sections.text_preview:

b. The MDT shall open an LFFS file that contains a valid Type-9 and Type-13 record, in acco

sections.title: 3.3.3 Deviation Log File
sections.text_preview: a. The MDT shall allow a user to save a text file containing a log of minutiae pairs with details and the resulting deviation calculations from the current user session. The text file will be in a tab

sections.title: 3.3.4 Session File
sections.text_preview: a. The MDT shall allow a user to save a session file containing all data from the LFFS files, Deviation Log file, and any actions taken within the session by the user that resulted in a change state.

sections.title: 3.4 CSCI Internal Interface Requirements
sections.text_preview: No internal interface requirements for the MDT.

sections.title: 3.5 CSCI Internal Data Requirements
sections.text_preview: No internal data requirements for the MDT.

sections.title: 3.6 Adaptation Requirements
sections.text_preview: No adaptation requirements for the MDT.

sections.title: 3.7 Safety Requirements
sections.text_preview: No safety requirements for the MDT.

sections.title: 3.8 Security and Privacy Requirements
sections.text_preview:
a. MDT will not provide per-user security setting. [T]

b. MDT will be able to operate in a standard DoD Information System (IS) Environment. [T]

sections.title: 3.9 CSCI Environment Requirements
sections.text_preview: a. MDT will operate in an office environment. [T]

sections.title: 3.10.1 Computer Hardware Requirements
sections.text_preview: a. MDT shall operate on a standard Government desktop computer. [T]

sections.title: 3.10.2 Computer Hardware Resource Utilization Requirements
sections.text_preview:
a. MDT will require a minimum 100 Megabytes (MB) of RAM. [T]

b. MDT will require a minimum 200 MB hard drive. [T]

sections.title: 3.10.3 Computer Software Requirements
sections.text_preview:
a. MDT will run in the Microsoft Windows 7 operating system. [T]

b. MDT will require Microsoft .Net Framework 4. [T]

sections.title: 3.10.4 Computer Communications Requirements
sections.text_preview: a. MDT shall not provide any network functionality. [T]
